status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY TEXT IS RENDERED AND BEFORE ANY NUMBER IS COMPUTED
why_a_hierarchy_is_required: Four cells will be computed. Without a pre-declared primary, whichever cell favours the preferred architecture could be selected after the fact. Exactly one cell is the gate; the rest are audit and sensitivity.

THE_GATE.decides: whether CVT_MEDIATOR nodes receive Dense/SPLADE encoding, i.e. whether retrieval_role flips off UNDECIDED_PENDING_CVT_GOLD_GATE

PRIMARY.question: Does CVT text expose gold evidence unavailable from entity identity text?
PRIMARY.rationale: Attribution. If a gold answer such as a marriage year lives only on a mediator, entity identity strings cannot surface it while the CVT record can. That is genuine retrieval-unit value from the CVT.

SECONDARY.question: Does CVT text still add lexical coverage after entity representations are relationally enriched?
SECONDARY.rationale: Enriched entity text can copy a CVT's arguments into the adjacent entity. If CVT-only coverage vanishes there, that does NOT show CVTs are useless -- it shows relationally enriched entity text can SUBSTITUTE for CVT indexing. A different and useful question, and not the gate.

MATCHING_HIERARCHY.sensitivity: both EXACT and NORMALIZED under ENTITY_TEXT = NAME_PLUS_FACTS
MATCHING_HIERARCHY.why_normalized_is_primary: Trailing whitespace or capitalization must not decide whether 1,588,085 nodes get embeddings. EXACT stays as the audit companion so a large EXACT/NORMALIZED gap is visible rather than hidden.

steps_in_order: collapse every run of whitespace to a single space
NORMALIZATION_FROZEN_BEFORE_RENDERING.applied_to: both sides identically -- the gold string and the rendered text
NORMALIZATION_FROZEN_BEFORE_RENDERING.match_predicate: plain substring containment of the normalized gold string in the normalized rendered text. Nothing else.

GOLD_DEFINITION.source: the 29 released RoG parquet shards, field 'answer'
GOLD_DEFINITION.cross_check: field 'a_entity' -- the distinct-string sets are IDENTICAL (33,655 each), so the choice of field cannot affect any result
GOLD_DEFINITION.unit_of_counting: DISTINCT gold answer strings. Occurrence-weighted figures are reported alongside but are not the gate.
GOLD_DEFINITION.query_independence: Gold strings are read ONLY to measure coverage. They never enter corpus membership, node identity, or rendered text. Standing rule: corpus <- source graph only; gold coverage <- measured afterward.

INTERPRETATION_MATRIX_FIXED_IN_ADVANCE.meaning: strong case for CVT retrieval units

relational entity enrichment can substitute for CVT indexing; sets up a direct tradeoff between short entity text + CVT records and richer entity text + no CVT index, to be compared later on coverage + token cost + pool composition + P50 exposure
counterintuitive -- inspect rendering and matching before believing it

no_numeric_cut_for_low_vs_high: Deliberately not pinned. The distribution is unmeasured and inventing a cut now would be a fabricated threshold. What is pinned is which single cell decides, which is where the knob would otherwise live.

RENDERING_RULES_FROZEN.CVT_record_text: structural header derived from the CVT asserted types, then one role-labelled argument line per incident edge. Role label = relation_label_qualified (user decision). Argument value = the neighbour display surface.
RENDERING_RULES_FROZEN.why_not_a_bag_of_neighbour_names: Neighbour text is an ARGUMENT, never node identity. 'Barack Obama Grammy Award 2008' loses the distinction the record exists to carry.
RENDERING_RULES_FROZEN.NAME_PLUS_FACTS_entity_text: display surface, plus direct non-CVT facts, PLUS the arguments of every adjacent CVT in either direction with the entity itself removed. The CVT-flattening is deliberate: it is the strongest form of the substitution hypothesis, so a finding that it still fails to substitute is robust.
RENDERING_RULES_FROZEN.MID_never_visible: No bare MID is ever emitted as a display surface (directive section 13, MID_VISIBLE_AS_DISPLAY_N = 0). MID_NAMED_ENTITY and UNRESOLVED_OTHER nodes render as a deterministic structural descriptor derived from incident schema, never a guessed name and never the MID.
RENDERING_RULES_FROZEN.consequence_accepted_in_advance: A gold answer that is the true name of a bare-MID entity will therefore match NOTHING and land in GOLD_IN_NEITHER_N. That is the honest result -- the information is genuinely absent from the released artifact -- and must not be repaired by leaking the MID into text.

CAPS.policy: No cap on arguments per CVT and no cap on facts per entity, so containment can never produce a false negative through truncation.
CAPS.if_a_cap_ever_becomes_necessary: it must be recorded here with the measured frequency at which it binds, before the affected numbers are read.

what_this_gate_does_NOT_decide: node_kind -- frozen at hash 5ea22695603972c00faa9cd5f1e36f1c6727bda495bc82b338a7b9b4b4f7ef04, independent of retrieval policy
any graph semantics, identity, or topology
retrieval_role for non-CVT kinds, which remains UNDECIDED_PENDING_RETRIEVAL_POLICY

RETRIEVAL_ROLE_RESOLVED_2026_09_06.resolution: ALL_NODE. Every canonical node is RETRIEVAL_ELIGIBLE.
RETRIEVAL_ROLE_RESOLVED_2026_09_06.supersedes_in_this_document: the standing of the gate itself. This document registered NAME_ONLY x NORMALIZED as the cell that would DECIDE CVT encoding. That framing is superseded: the gate is retained as analysis and no longer functions as an on/off switch. The pre-registration did its job -- it prevented cell-shopping and the recorded value stands exactly as measured -- but the question it was built to answer (does CVT text expose unique answer vocabulary) turned out not to be the question that governs CVT retrieval in CRAG (does a CVT provide routing evidence for the partition containing it).
